title: Sasha Salzano-Weir
description: Education, work experience and software projects by Sasha Salzano-Weir, a computer science student at RWTH Aachen and software developer at HumanityLink.
intro: I study computer science at RWTH Aachen and write software at HumanityLink. Most of my work there is on EmpowerLink, which humanitarian organisations use to reach people by text and run surveys over the phone.

schools.name: RWTH Aachen University
schools.detail: I focus on system design, high-performance computing and machine learning.

schools.name: UWC Red Cross Nordic
schools.detail: My Higher Level subjects were Mathematics, Physics and Economics. Alongside the IB I was already doing RWTH programming exercises.

jobs.name: HumanityLink
jobs.detail: I built the SMS and WhatsApp tools that NGOs use for outreach, and wrote voice surveys in TwiML. The backend connects Express, EspoCRM and Twilio. I deploy it to Google Kubernetes Engine with Terraform. Projects at HumanityLink

jobs.name: Private client
jobs.detail: Jonas Schledorn’s photography portfolio runs on SvelteKit. I built the site and set up the virtual server and Nginx reverse proxy that serve it.

jobs.name: Der TAkt
jobs.detail: Der TAkt proposed putting AR screens in public spaces to collect residents’ feedback. I built the browser prototype in A-Frame, set up deployments with GitHub Actions and made a live survey dashboard. The team won €10,000 in Aachen’s Smart City ideas competition.

jobs.name: Laboratory for Machine Tools and Production Engineering
jobs.detail: I used a regression model as a virtual CNC mill to test a reinforcement learning controller. After comparing approaches, I prototyped one using proximal policy optimization and presented the results to the lab.

jobs.name: Beyond Communications
jobs.detail: I monitored networks and devices, fixed server incidents and helped customers with technical problems. Software upgrades also came through me, from compatibility checks to documentation.

jobs.name: Aquaculture automation startup
jobs.detail: My job was to find the fish in the images. I built the segmentation pipeline in Keras, cleaned the datasets with Python and Bash, and explored them with Pandas and Seaborn.

processor_alt: waveProcessor interface with three waveshapers, each showing its own transfer curve.
synth_description: is a polyphonic wavetable synth I wrote in C++ with JUCE. It does resampling, downsampling and hard or soft distortion.
processor: is a waveshaping plug-in I built with iPlug2. Its three waveshapers can run in series or in parallel. Each one plots what it does to the signal.
geopolitics_detail: is a PM4Py extension I wrote to study exchanges between countries. For the US and Germany, I graphed which actions in one direction were followed by actions in the other within a chosen number of days.

projects.name: EmpowerLink
projects.detail: The original outreach platform. I worked on its core and email APIs, EspoCRM extension and Twilio voice surveys.

projects.name: EmpowerLink Unified
projects.detail: I’m working on a version that can run independently of the CRM. PostgreSQL row-level security keeps organisations’ records separate, and an outbox feeds the delivery queues.

projects.name: Share & Listen
projects.detail: A monday.com app for SMS, WhatsApp and RCS. One mode runs a questionnaire. The other answers from an organisation’s own material and can pass the conversation into a survey.

projects.name: ANCHOR for Farmers
projects.detail: Work has just started on this project for GOAL Honduras, funded by Irish Aid. The aim is to send planting advice in Spanish over WhatsApp using satellite data and weather forecasts.
